textDisplay: Saved me a tow. My 6BTA ran hot off Owls Head last August and your strainer check was the first thing I tried. Eelgrass clog. Thank you.
Cap. Going to have you walk me through the heat exchanger one of these Saturdays.
The bottom bolt is the worst. Same on the Cummins 6CTA. Stub wrench is the only way.
Stub wrench and a bad word. Yes.
Which impeller kit are you running. Sherwood or Jabsco.
The one on the rudder shoe always disappears first. Every year.
Defender Marine got the kit to me in three days. Thanks for the link.
My first season. Bait bag tip on the loop knot helped a lot. Thank you sir.
Teaching my kid this weekend. This is the version I learned too.
Looks square. Pine frame is going to creak in two winters though. Bring it inside before the wood stove.
The shed is colder than the harbor. It will be fine. See you Saturday.
The barometer at 3 AM versus the forecast at 4 AM. That part lined up with the worst day of my season.
Solid list cap. See you on the 9th.
The truck will be in the driveway. I will keep an eye on things.
